# Standard Payment Setup

The standard entry to shared Payment Setup. Its `build` function delegates to `buildInstruction` with empty overrides, details, method clauses and instruction patch. Consequently the shared defaults and validation determine the amount, currency, parties, request connections, placement and stable instruction identity.

This helper selects no external provider or confirmation adapter. Building an instruction is separate from its Activation approvals, guarantor acceptance and confirmed financial outcomes. Request actions remain in the Payment Instruction by default; explicit agreement sources require the shared lowering and initialized-host checks.
